images.title: ON, OFF, ON, OFF
images.purpose: Show that a switch that flips with every press is ON after the odd presses and OFF after the even presses.
images.composition: Eight torch pictures for presses 1 to 8, alternately ON and OFF, with the rule below.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. A row of eight torch pictures for presses 1 to 8. The title Press by press in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (56 px) is centred at x 728, y 90. EIGHT ROUNDED RECTANGLES, each 150 by 220 px, y 250 to 470, at x 58 to 208, 228 to 378, 398 to 548, 568 to 718, 738 to 888, 908 to 1058, 1078 to 1228 and 1248 to 1398, outlined dark #2B2B2B 3 px. The 1st, 3rd, 5th and 7th are filled amber #E69F00 and show the word ON in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (56 px) centred; the 2nd, 4th, 6th and 8th are filled pale grey #D9D9D9 and show the word OFF in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (56 px) centred. Under each rectangle, centred on it at y 520, its press number 1 to 8 in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (64 px). Under the row, centred at x 728, y 640, the line odd presses give ON in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (48 px) and at y 710 the line even presses give OFF in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (48 px). No other text. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
a torch ON on an even press
a torch OFF on an odd press
images.takeaway: ON after an odd press, OFF after an even press.
images.description: Eight torches for presses 1 to 8: ON, OFF, ON, OFF, ON, OFF, ON, OFF.
images.context: Concept image for ON and OFF, Press by Press. It shows the first eight presses, which are general and not a book number.
images.teaching_notes: Read the press numbers and the words together. The slip to watch: believing the 14th press needs fourteen presses to find out.

image_decisions.why: The alternating row of pictures is the pattern.
